title: route_hash over hop ADDRESSES (16B): Rust lichen-gateway tunnel_auth migration
description: Spec changed (5muj): 06-security.md §8.11 route_hash now hashes full 16-byte hop ADDRESSES (concat hop[i].addr -> SHA-256[0:16]), not 8-byte IIDs — a 02xx primary embeds no IID post-AddrForKey. rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs currently: route_hash(hops: &[[u8; 8]]) -> SHA-256 over hop bytes; DecapsulationRequest.route: &[[u8; 8]]; egress check 'route.last() == claim.egress_iid'. Migrate: hops become &[[u8; 16]] (full SRH hop addresses); route.last() compares the full 16-byte egress address against the claim's egress identity (egress_iid claim may need to become egress_addr [u8;16] or the comparison derives the address from the pinned egress pubkey via AddrForKey). Callers: gateway.rs DecapsulationRequest construction (must pass SRH 16-byte hops, not addr[8:16] slices), tunnel_auth_vectors.rs. COORDINATE with the shared-vector child (test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json route_hash + identity address_hex fields must regenerate to AddrForKey form) — do not land against stale vectors. Discovered-from 5muj.
